subject: general
question: Rajiv Mehrishi has been elected as external auditor of which international organisation from 2020 to 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**WHO.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajiv Mehrishi** has been elected as** external auditor of the World Health Organization (WHO).**
 
• He has been elected for four years from **2020 to 2023.**
 
• He was elected at the** 72nd World Health Assembly **in **Geneva **in **May 2019.**
 
• This is the second major international audit assignment for the CAG this year.
 
• First was his selection for the post of External Auditor of Food and Agriculture Organization in Rome earlier this year in March 2019.
 
• Mehrishi is also on the Board of Auditors of the United Nations and Vice-Chair of the UN Panel of External Auditors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rajiv Mehrishi was the 13th Comptroller and Auditor General of India (C&AG).
 
• He was the Vice Chairman of the United Nations Panel of External Auditors.
 
• He is a retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 1978 batch belonging to the Rajasthan cadre.
 
• He was appointed the Home Secretary of India on 31 August 2015.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Bhushan, India's third highest civilian award, in 2022.
